lead_raw_text:
The structure of Al2Zn2Ag4 (reduced formula AlZnAg2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for all three elements: Al and Zn each have eight Ag neighbors, while Ag has four Al and four Zn neighbors, all at 2.7052 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner, edge, and face sharing among Ag-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, with corner and face sharing between Al- and Zn-centered polyhedra.
